name: Sunstorm channels Justice every second and locks out other abilities (#976)
contract: Sunstorm 760379 has three engine-native aura effects, no custom handler needed. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL (23), EffectTriggerSpell 572848 (Justice), EffectAmplitude 1000 ms, DurationIndex 32 (SpellDuration.dbc row 32 = 6000 ms, matching 'for the next 6 sec'); AttributesEx5 512 = SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD ('Immediately do periodic tick on apply', SharedDefines.h:632), so the first Justice cast fires immediately and AuraEffect::HandlePeriodicTriggerSpellAuraTick (SpellAuraEffects.cpp) repeats it every 1000 ms for 6000 ms (6 casts). Effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_ALLOW_ONLY_ABILITY (263, AuraEffect::HandleAuraAllowOnlyAbility), which sets PLAYER_ALLOW_ONLY_ABILITY; Spell::CheckCast (Spell.cpp:5754) then fails any further non-triggered, non-melee-swing player cast with SPELL_FAILED_SPELL_IN_PROGRESS, while HandlePeriodicTriggerSpellAuraTick casts Justice with TRIGGERED_FULL_MASK (includes TRIGGERED_IGNORE_CASTER_AURASTATE), which bypasses that same check -- matching 'you can move but cannot perform any other abilities'. Effect 1 (SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_IMMUNITY_MASK, 147, MiscValue 1733) is likewise handled natively by AuraEffect::HandleModStateImmunityMask and is not separately asserted here. This scenario proves the two clearly testable clauses: the periodic self-cast and the ability lockout, both delivered with zero script/SQL.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Control casts Sunwalker on itself outside Sunstorm
Sunwalker applies normally without Sunstorm active
Clear Sunstorm's own GCD so the next rejection is attributable to PLAYER_ALLOW_ONLY_ABILITY, not the GCD
Test tries to cast Sunwalker while Sunstorm is still active
Sunwalker is rejected while PLAYER_ALLOW_ONLY_ABILITY is set
Let Sunstorm's 6 second duration and its periodic ticks finish
Justice fired at cast time plus five more ticks over the 6 second duration
